strings.string: Approximate decibels from the watch microphone, which is not A-weighted and not a calibrated meter. The danger range follows NIOSH: 85 dB for 8 hours a day, half the time for every 3 dB more.
Added to the microphone's own scale. Hold the watch beside a phone sound meter and match the numbers; UP and DOWN on the Calibrate screen do the same.
A short buzz when the level rises past the hearing-risk line, a longer one past the loud-venue line, at most once every 15 seconds.
